brand_spec.notes: Heading font override from Merriweather to Lora applied per VisualDirection typography_delta. Stitch unavailable; tokens applied exactly per BrandSpec.

visual_direction.primary_change: Typography refinement - Lora serif headings, Source Sans 3 body, classical 400ms cubic-bezier motion with scale(1.02) hover, elevated card treatment for service cards.
visual_direction.rationale: Classical liberal arts brand personality requires refined, contemplative aesthetics. Lora conveys established credibility and warmth for mission-driven clients. Classical motion philosophy (400ms spring) applied consistently. Source Sans 3 body ensures readability while preserving warm tone.
designer_notes: Classical motion philosophy (400ms ease-out with spring) applied to all interactive elements
Service cards use elevated variant with larger hover shadow for visual hierarchy
Portfolio gallery uses motion-subtle (opacity) to avoid competing with case study content
Contact form inputs feature subtle border-color transition
All colors trace to BrandSpec tokens - primary_color #1E293B for headings, accent_color #7C3AED for interactive accents
Footer social links use ghost button styling with motion-subtle
Dark mode uses [data-theme=dark] with inverted BrandSpec tokens via full_tokens strategy

ui_polish_changes.change: Replaced default Tailwind 0.5rem radius with BrandSpec 0.375rem token via --radius-default and borderRadius.DEFAULT
ui_polish_changes.reason: Align card/button/input radii to brand_spec.border_radius for consistent geometry

ui_polish_changes.change: Added .motion-classical, .motion-subtle, .motion-monastic utility classes with 400ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), 200ms ease-out, 300ms ease-out respectively
ui_polish_changes.reason: Translate motion_philosophy 'classical' into concrete CSS per VisualDirection motion_delta

ui_polish_changes.change: Added [data-theme='dark'] block with full inverted BrandSpec tokens (primary becomes #F1F5F9, background #0F172A, accent #818CF8)
ui_polish_changes.reason: Honor dark_mode_strategy=full_tokens; all surface/border/text values flip consistently

ui_polish_changes.change: Added @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) override that disables card-hover scale and btn-primary transform
ui_polish_changes.reason: Required accessibility guard for users with vestibular sensitivities; keeps opacity transitions

ui_polish_changes.change: Loaded Lora (ital,wght 400-700) and Source Sans 3 (400-700) via Google Fonts preconnect + display=swap
ui_polish_changes.reason: Apply VisualDirection typography_hierarchy h1-h3 Lora family and h4/body Source Sans 3

ui_polish_changes.change: Replaced single h1 with editorial eyebrow label, large serif h1 (clamp 2.25-3.75rem), 1.25rem subheadline, and dual CTA (primary Let's Talk + secondary Explore Services)
ui_polish_changes.reason: Preserve Variant A's mission-forward voice; add editorial hierarchy for classical typography feel

ui_polish_changes.change: Cards use card-elevated variant with .card-hover applying scale(1.02) + translateY(-2px) + shadow-lg on hover; icon wrapped in primary-container (accent.50) square
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection elevated card treatment for services section; classical motion via motion-classical

ui_polish_changes.change: Responsive grid: 1 col mobile, 2 col sm (640px), 4 col lg (1024px) per VisualDirection responsive_columns
Added numeric accent badge (-top-4 -left-4 circle in accent color) anchored to each step card for stronger editorial feel
ui_polish_changes.reason: Reinforce sequential process narrative without violating minimal motion philosophy

ui_polish_changes.change: Replaced 5-up gallery with 3-up responsive grid (1/2/3 cols at 640/768/1024) using 16:10 thumbnail aspect ratio with object-cover
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection page_layouts.portfolio responsive_columns; improves thumbnail legibility from blur placeholders

ui_polish_changes.change: Built form with react-hook-form + zod schema (firstName, lastName, company?, projectType?, email required, phone?); aria-required + aria-invalid; error messages announced via role=alert
ui_polish_changes.reason: Per Variant A preserve, low-pressure conversational form retained with full a11y wiring

ui_polish_changes.change: Portrait framed in elevated card with surface background; body content in two-column grid (auto / 1fr) stacking to single col on mobile
ui_polish_changes.reason: VisualDirection about layout: two-column portrait+content, stacked on 768px

ui_polish_changes.change: Sticky header with backdrop-blur, native mobile menu toggle (aria-expanded), CTA 'Let's Talk' button always visible in primary color
ui_polish_changes.reason: Preserve CTA prominence; add mobile nav with semantic aria-label and aria-expanded for a11y

ui_polish_changes.change: All form inputs get :hover border secondary, :focus border accent + 3px rgba(99,102,241,0.15) ring; label above input with 6px gap
ui_polish_changes.reason: Motion_class_map form_input_focus: motion-subtle; visible focus state honors a11y (no outline:none without replacement)

ui_polish_changes.change: Centered single-column footer with logo, contact info (mail/tel), social ghost-buttons (LinkedIn, GitHub, X), secondary nav, copyright
ui_polish_changes.reason: Preserve footer hierarchy from site_understanding; social links use btn-ghost + motion-subtle per VisualDirection

ui_polish_changes.change: Added .skip-link utility (sr-only until :focus, then top:8px high-contrast) and applied in layout.tsx wrapping <main>
ui_polish_changes.reason: Skip link was present in source text content; required for a11y and Lighthouse a11y score ≥90

visual_weight_issues: Hero h1 reaches 3.75rem at desktop; service card h3 at 20px creates moderate contrast gap — acceptable given editorial intent
Footer logo at 80x80 is larger than typical web footer; justified by single-column centered layout
typography_hierarchy_suggestions: Could add a slight font-feature-settings: 'liga', 'kern' to Lora headings to fully enable contextual alternates
Process step badge numeral currently uses font-heading Lora at 18px — could be tightened with tighter letter-spacing for editorial gravitas
emotional_resonance_gaps: Mission-forward Variant A voice preserved verbatim ('Showcase Your Mission', 'Don't resign yourself to mediocrity')
Personal warmth maintained via 'Let's Talk', 'I'd Love to Hear From You' CTAs — Variant A rationale honored
brand_token_violations: VisualDirection designer_notes mention accent_color #7C3AED; brand_spec.accent_color is #6366F1. Applied BrandSpec value (#6366F1) per gap-ledger rule and logged here.
No hardcoded hex values inside any component — all colors via Tailwind tokens or CSS custom properties
self_critique.recommended_action: Add builder_specialist.md note: VisualDirection designer_notes are advisory only; color_delta is the authoritative source. Future runs should only override BrandSpec when a value appears in color_delta/typography_delta/motion_delta, not in designer_notes.

deployment_readiness.notes: next.config.js output:'export' configured; run `npm install && npm run build` to produce ./out static bundle deployable to Fly.io / Vercel / Netlify / S3+CloudFront.

rework_log.resolution: Kept brand_spec.accent_color #6366F1 per gap-ledger rule; logged in brand_token_violations and self_critique.recommended_action
Applied VisualDirection page_layouts + typography_hierarchy + motion_class_map verbatim; no new visual choices introduced per stitch_status='unavailable' guidance
